Name: Cask Speed-Up Multipler by Semoo
Author: Semoo910
Description:
DESCRIPTION
Cask Speed Multiplier lets you choose how fast casks age your artisan goods. Whether you want a small boost or barely any waiting at all, you can set the speed that suits your playthrough.

INSTALLATION
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu to change the setting in-game.
3. Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.
5. Choose your speed in the mod options. Without Generic Mod Config Menu, edit the config.json file that appears in the mod folder after the first launch.

MAIN FEATURES
- 15 speed options from 0.5x to 56x (1x is the normal game speed, 2x is the default)
- Works with wine, beer, mead, pale ale, cheese and goat cheese
- Each item keeps its normal aging rate relative to the others, multiplied by your chosen speed
- Quality tiers and sell prices stay the same
- Doesn't replace any game files

GOOD TO KNOW
- Casks still age overnight, so progress happens when a new day starts, not by the hour.
- A new speed only applies to items placed in a cask after you change it.
- Items made cask-compatible by other mods keep their normal speed.

REQUIREMENTS
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for the in-game settings menu)

SHOUT OUTS
Thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher, and spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu.
